Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1613836. Join activities to assays on assay_id and to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613836', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
